title: DTQEM v12.2: Time‑Sovereignty Model of Quantum Entanglement
description: DTQEM v12.2 is an open‑source, numerically exact simulation of two‑qubit entanglement under thermal decoherence and magnetic fields. It solves the Lindblad master equation via Liouvillian exponentiation, offers all standard entanglement metrics, inverse calibration, and a unique testable prediction (V = D at θ = 90°). The Time‑Sovereignty interpretation provides an intuitive picture of the observer effect.
